name: Interactive Parameters
description: Demonstrate @param widgets: sliders, dropdowns, checkboxes, and more. Change values and cells auto-execute.

cells.code:
# Interactive Parameters with @param

Use `# @param` annotations to create interactive widgets above your code cells.
When you change a widget value, the cell **auto-executes** with the new value.

**Supported types:** slider, dropdown, text, number, checkbox, date

Try changing the controls below!

# First, load some data to work with
df = sample_data('orders')
df['total'] = pd.to_numeric(df['total'], errors='coerce')
df['quantity'] = pd.to_numeric(df['quantity'], errors='coerce')
print(f"Loaded {len(df)} rows")
df.head(3)

# @param {"type": "slider", "min": 10, "max": 500, "step": 10, "default": 100}
sample_size = 100

sampled = df.head(sample_size)
print(f"Showing {len(sampled)} rows")
sampled.describe()

# @param {"type": "text", "default": "total", "placeholder": "column name"}
column_name = "total"

if column_name in df.columns:
    col = pd.to_numeric(df[column_name], errors='coerce').dropna()
    print(f"Stats for '{column_name}':")
    print(f"  Mean: {col.mean():.2f}")
    print(f"  Median: {col.median():.2f}")
    print(f"  Std: {col.std():.2f}")
    plot_histogram(df, column_name, title=f'Distribution of {column_name}')
else:
    print(f"Column '{column_name}' not found. Available: {list(df.columns)}")

# @param {"type": "date", "default": "2024-06-01"}
start_date = "2024-06-01"

import pandas as pd
df['order_date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['order_date'])
after_date = df[df['order_date'] >= start_date]
print(f"Orders after {start_date}: {len(after_date)}")

if len(after_date) > 0:
    daily = after_date.groupby('order_date')['total'].sum().reset_index()
    plot_line(daily, x='order_date', y='total', title=f'Daily Revenue (from {start_date})')
else:
    print("No orders in this date range.")
